name: poly(A)-specific ribonuclease
pathways: positive regulation of telomere maintenance via telomerase

function.text: PARN encodes poly(A)-specific ribonuclease PARN. Annotated molecular activities include nuclease activity and 3'-5'-RNA exonuclease activity. It participates in positive regulation of telomere maintenance via telomerase and RNA modification.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to pulmonary fibrosis and/or bone marrow failure, Telomere-related, 4 (semidominant); dyskeratosis congenita, autosomal recessive 6 (autosomal recessive).

function.text: PARN encodes poly(A)-specific ribonuclease PARN. It interacts with both the 3'-end poly(A) tail and the 5'-end cap structure during degradation, the interaction with the cap structure being required for an efficient degradation of poly(A) tails. It participates in nonsense-mediated mRNA decay, a critical process of selective degradation of mRNAs that contain premature stop codons.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with pulmonary fibrosis and/or bone marrow failure, Telomere-related, 4 (semidominant); dyskeratosis congenita, autosomal recessive 6 (autosomal recessive).
